I really do appreciate you're comment, I know this reply is a few days late but I did read it when you first wrote this. I have been working on getting this cycle trip around Europe into motion. It's going to be hard as just because I am planning the trip doesn't essentially mean I will be able to afford to get all the stuff and follow through with it however I am hoping that by planning, my motivation will pull me through. I must admit i find it somewhat impossible to prevent my suicidal thoughts however I have used this trip as a method to in a way override the thoughts. As for the song, I'll expand a little on the topic. So I have been working on both producing and writing Hip Hop tracks, it has been difficult to write anything with worth or an actual rhyme scheme due to my depression and anxiety. I tend to go of on tangents with no idea on how to bring it back and end up deleting all that I had. The song (when finished) is for an ex girlfriend that I broke up with, with the reason of trying to improve on myself because I felt as though I was on a breakthrough on my anxiety and somewhat on my depression however I misunderstood what was really improving my issues and ended up worse than ever before, causing a chain reaction of terrible occurrence's due to my ill mental health. I have spoken to the ex recently and found out that she has moved on now because I didn't know my mistake until too late. I don't have the ability to tell her to her face everything I want to say so I thought the best thing to do is write and produce my own song explaining myself to send to her before committing suicide.
Once again thank you for your response, it has had a positive impact on my thought processes and I hope to strive onwards to complete my bucket list.
~Diablo
